0.overview: Our neuro-oncology team specializes in the precise resection of both benign and malignant brain tumors, combining advanced imaging with microsurgical technique to maximize tumor removal while protecting healthy neural tissue.
points: Intraoperative MRI and neuro-navigation for real-time precision
Awake craniotomy available for tumors near critical brain regions
Multidisciplinary tumor board for personalized treatment planning

1.overview: We perform complex spinal reconstruction and alignment procedures to correct deformities, stabilize fractures, and relieve nerve compression, using modern instrumentation designed for durability and faster recovery.
points: Computer-assisted screw placement for enhanced accuracy
Minimally invasive approaches to reduce blood loss
Custom rehabilitation plans for every patient

2.overview: Herniated discs are treated with minimally invasive decompression techniques that relieve pressure on spinal nerves, easing pain and restoring mobility with significantly shorter recovery than traditional open surgery.
points: Microdiscectomy through a small incision
Preserves surrounding muscle and ligament structures
Most patients resume light activity within days

3.overview: Using high-definition endoscopic cameras and specialized keyhole instruments, we access deep neurological structures through incisions as small as a few millimeters, minimizing trauma and scarring.
points: High-definition visualization of the surgical field
Reduced hospital stay compared to open procedures
Suitable for select brain and spinal conditions

4.overview: Our peripheral nerve program restores function and sensation through microsurgical nerve repair, decompression, and reconstruction, helping patients recover mobility after injury or chronic compression.
points: Microsurgical nerve grafting and repair
Nerve conduction studies guide precise diagnosis
Focused physical therapy supports full recovery

5.overview: We provide specialized, compassionate neurosurgical care for infants and children, addressing congenital conditions and acquired injuries with techniques adapted to a growing nervous system.
points: Child-specific surgical planning and anesthesia protocols
Family-centered care throughout treatment
Long-term developmental follow-up

6.overview: Skull base tumors and lesions require a multidisciplinary approach; our team combines neurosurgery, ENT, and advanced imaging to safely access this complex anatomical region with minimal disruption.
points: Joint neurosurgery and ENT surgical teams
Endoscopic endonasal approaches when appropriate
Comprehensive pre- and post-operative imaging

7.overview: We manage cerebrospinal fluid disorders through shunt placement and endoscopic third ventriculostomy (ETV), restoring normal fluid balance and relieving pressure on the brain.
points: Programmable shunt systems for precise fluid control
ETV as a shunt-free alternative when suitable
Ongoing monitoring to detect complications early

8.overview: Brain hemorrhage is a medical emergency; our team provides rapid vascular intervention and surgical evacuation to control bleeding and reduce pressure on brain tissue, prioritizing speed and precision.
points: 24/7 emergency neurosurgical response
Minimally invasive clot evacuation techniques
Coordinated critical care and rehabilitation

9.overview: We perform precise removal of intradural and extradural spinal tumors, using intraoperative neuromonitoring to protect spinal cord function throughout the procedure.
points: Intraoperative neuromonitoring for spinal cord safety
Tumor resection with spinal stability preservation
Coordinated oncology follow-up when needed

items.question: What technologies are used in your surgical navigation?
items.answer: We utilize the Precision-7 AI system, which combines real-time intraoperative MRI data with holographic augmented reality overlays for 0.1mm surgical guidance. This ensures the highest level of anatomical safety.

items.question: How do I schedule a specialized consultation?
items.answer: You can use our integrated Patient Portal for direct scheduling. For urgent evaluations, please call our emergency concierge line to receive a priority assessment within 24 hours.

items.question: Do you offer second opinions on existing scans?
items.answer: Yes, our dedicated Scan Viewer portal allows you to securely upload DICOM files for a comprehensive remote review. Following upload, Dr. Mowafy will provide a detailed report.

0.overview: Minimally invasive spine surgery (MISS) uses specialized instruments and imaging to treat spinal conditions with smaller incisions, less muscle damage, and faster recovery.
0.diagnosis: Diagnosis typically involves MRI, CT scans, and physical neurological assessment.
0.treatment: Using tubular retractors and endoscopic cameras, the surgeon corrects herniated discs or stenosis.
0.recovery: Most patients return home within 24 hours. Full activity returning in 4-6 weeks.
0.faq: Is it safer than open surgery? Yes, generally lower risk of infection.

1.overview: The surgical removal of abnormal growths within the skull, utilizing advanced neuro-navigation and microscopic tools to maximize resection.
1.diagnosis: High-resolution MRI with contrast and functional imaging (fMRI) are used.
1.treatment: Microsurgical techniques combined with intraoperative monitoring ensure the highest safety.
1.recovery: Hospital stay ranges from 3-7 days. Rehabilitation may follow.
1.faq: Will I be awake? Only for Awake Craniotomy in critical areas.

items.question: What is the recovery time for spine surgery?
items.answer: Recovery varies by procedure. Minimally invasive surgeries often allow patients to return home the same day, while complex cases may require 2-4 days of hospitalization. Full recovery typically takes 4-12 weeks.

items.question: Do you offer second opinions?
items.answer: Yes, Dr. Osama Mowafy provides comprehensive second-opinion consultations for complex neurological diagnoses to ensure patients have full confidence in their treatment path.

items.question: Is neurosurgery always the first option?
items.answer: No. Our philosophy is to explore conservative, non-surgical treatments first whenever possible. Surgery is recommended only when it is the most effective path.

items.question: What insurances do you accept?
items.answer: We accept a wide range of international and local medical insurance providers. Please contact our front desk for a specific list.

items.question: How can I prepare for my first visit?
items.answer: Please bring all recent MRI/CT scans (on CD if possible), a list of current medications, and any prior surgical reports related to your condition.

items.question: Are minimally invasive procedures safer?
items.answer: MISS generally carries lower risks of infection and blood loss, and results in less post-operative pain compared to traditional open surgery.

items.question: What is the success rate for tumor removals?
items.answer: Success rates vary by tumor type and location. Dr. Mowafy uses intraoperative navigation to maximize safety and efficacy for every case.

items.question: Can I travel after neurosurgery?
items.answer: Most patients are advised to wait 2-6 weeks before flying, depending on the specific procedure performed and their individual recovery progress.

items.question: How do I manage pain after surgery?
items.answer: A personalized pain management plan, including medication and physical therapy, is provided to every patient before they are discharged.

items.question: Do you perform surgeries on international patients?
items.answer: Yes, we regularly host patients from across the globe and can assist with medical visa documentation and local accommodation coordination.

popup.clinicalOverviewBody: Modern neurosurgical approaches are increasingly focused on reducing patient morbidity while maximizing therapeutic precision. Through the integration of advanced imaging modalities and robot-assisted navigation, surgeons can now access deep-seated lesions with sub-millimeter accuracy. This section explores the fundamental shifts in clinical practice over the last decade.
popup.point1: Enhanced visualization via high-definition microscopy and intraoperative MRI.
popup.point2: Reduced incision sizes leading to decreased hospital stays and faster return to daily activities.
popup.point3: Advanced biocompatible materials used in spinal stabilization and cranial reconstruction.
popup.point4: Personalized recovery protocols tailored to individual neural plasticity.
popup.pullQuote: "Precision in neurosurgery is not merely about the tools we use, but the deep understanding of the patient's unique neural architecture. Every procedure is a blend of high-end engineering and human compassion."
popup.outcomesBody: Clinical data consistently shows that patients undergoing minimally invasive procedures experience up to 40% reduction in post-operative pain and significantly lower infection rates. Current research at Osama Mowafy Neurosurgery continues to push the boundaries of what is possible in neuro-regeneration, exploring pharmacological and mechanical stimuli to enhance nerve repair.
